section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses theoretical and empirical links between body appreciation and need for uniqueness, including distinctive appearance investment and potential moderators such as sex, BMI, and race/ethnicity. It states that both a general need-for-uniqueness measure and an appearance-specific measure were included in the current study and that sex was examined as a potential moderator.
section_summary.evidence_source: Examples: 'a general measure of need for uniqueness as well as one more specific to appearance (i.e., distinctive appearance investment; Tiggemann & Golder, 2006) were included in the current study.' and 'We also examined the modifying effect of sex on body appreciation and need for uniqueness...'.
